import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 300;
    static final int INFINITY = 1000000000;

    static class Connection {
        int destination;
        int reverse_index;
        int current_flow;
        int max_capacity;

        Connection(int d, int r, int f, int c) {
            destination = d;
            reverse_index = r;
            current_flow = f;
            max_capacity = c;
        }
    }

    static List<Connection>[] network = new List[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] next_edge = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int source_node, sink_node;

    static void connect_nodes(int from, int to, int capacity, int reverse_capacity) {
        network[from].add(new Connection(to, network[to].size(), 0, capacity));
        network[to].add(new Connection(from, network[from].size() - 1, 0, reverse_capacity));
    }

    static boolean compute_levels() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[source_node] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source_node);
        while (!q.isEmpty() && level[sink_node] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Connection conn : network[u]) {
                int v = conn.destination;
                if (level[v] == -1 && conn.current_flow < conn.max_capacity) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink_node] != -1;
    }

    static int push_flow(int node, int bottleneck) {
        if (node == sink_node || bottleneck == 0) return bottleneck;
        for (int i = next_edge[node]; i < network[node].size(); i++) {
            next_edge[node] = i;
            Connection conn = network[node].get(i);
            int next_node = conn.destination;
            if (level[next_node] != level[node] + 1) continue;
            int augment = push_flow(next_node, Math.min(bottleneck, conn.max_capacity - conn.current_flow));
            if (augment > 0) {
                conn.current_flow += augment;
                network[next_node].get(conn.reverse_index).current_flow -= augment;
                return augment;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int calculate_max_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (compute_levels()) {
            Arrays.fill(next_edge, 0);
            int augment;
            while ((augment = push_flow(source_node, INFINITY)) > 0) {
                total += augment;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static final int[] row_offsets = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static final int[] col_offsets = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int grid_dimension, max_time;
    static int[][] obstacles, time_constraints, shortest_paths;
    static String[] initial_grid, target_grid;

    static void multi_source_bfs(int start_row, int start_col, int[][] distance_map, boolean apply_time_limit) {
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dimension; i++)
            Arrays.fill(distance_map[i], -1);
        distance_map[start_row][start_col] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> bfs_queue = new LinkedList<>();
        bfs_queue.offer(new int[]{start_row, start_col});
        while (!bfs_queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfs_queue.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            if (apply_time_limit && distance_map[r][c] == time_constraints[r][c]) continue;
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int new_r = r + row_offsets[dir];
                int new_c = c + col_offsets[dir];
                if (new_r < 0 || new_r >= grid_dimension || new_c < 0 || new_c >= grid_dimension ||
                    distance_map[new_r][new_c] != -1 || obstacles[new_r][new_c] != 0) continue;
                if (apply_time_limit && time_constraints[new_r][new_c] > -1 &&
                    distance_map[r][c] + 1 > time_constraints[new_r][new_c]) continue;
                distance_map[new_r][new_c] = distance_map[r][c] + 1;
                bfs_queue.offer(new int[]{new_r, new_c});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        grid_dimension = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        max_time = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        initial_grid = new String[grid_dimension];
        target_grid = new String[grid_dimension];
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dimension; i++) {
            initial_grid[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dimension; i++) {
            target_grid[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        obstacles = new int[grid_dimension][grid_dimension];
        time_constraints = new int[grid_dimension][grid_dimension];
        shortest_paths = new int[grid_dimension][grid_dimension];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dimension; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_dimension; j++) {
                obstacles[i][j] = (initial_grid[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_dimension; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_dimension; j++) {
                if (initial_grid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    multi_source_bfs(i, j, time_constraints, false);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            network[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        source_node = 2 * grid_dimension * grid_dimension + 5;
        sink_node = source_node + 1;
        
        for (int x = 0; x < grid_dimension; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < grid_dimension; y++) {
                if (initial_grid[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' || initial_grid[x].charAt(y) == 'Y') continue;
                connect_nodes(source_node, grid_dimension * x + y, initial_grid[x].charAt(y) - '0', 0);
                connect_nodes(grid_dimension * grid_dimension + grid_dimension * x + y, sink_node, target_grid[x].charAt(y) - '0', 0);
                multi_source_bfs(x, y, shortest_paths, true);
                for (int xp = 0; xp < grid_dimension; xp++) {
                    for (int yp = 0; yp < grid_dimension; yp++) {
                        if (shortest_paths[xp][yp] != -1 && shortest_paths[xp][yp] <= max_time) {
                            connect_nodes(grid_dimension * x + y, grid_dimension * grid_dimension + grid_dimension * xp + yp, INFINITY, 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(calculate_max_flow());
    }
}
